## Product GM - EA Engagement Model

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Foundation](../../README.md) • [Engagements](../README.md) • [Product](README.md)**

---

> This document defines the EA engagement model and architecture team for the Gainwell Platform product domain, which delivers foundational platform capabilities, cloud infrastructure, databases, and automation tooling supporting all Gainwell products.

### 1.2 ITO Infrastructure Team

| Role | Name | Focus Area |
| ---- | ---- | ---------- |
| **Senior Director** | Ken Vachon | ITO Infrastructure leadership and strategic direction |
| **Director, Engineering** | Jeff Carpin | Core Platform Development - Platform services, APIs, and foundational capabilities |
| **Director, Engineering** | Brian Doss | Cloud Engineering - Multi-cloud infrastructure, IaC, and cloud operations |
| **Sr. Manager, Service Delivery** | Doug Cobb | Architecture & Solutioning - Infrastructure standards and technical solutioning |
| **Sr. Manager, Service Delivery** | Ralph Silva | Databases - Database platforms, design, and data services |
| **Sr. Manager, Service Delivery** | Shashank Kharel | Toolchain & Automation - CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling |

[foundation/engagements/product/ea-platform.md#14-cross-organizational-service-requests]

### 1.4 Cross-Organizational Service Requests

| Service Type | Initiated By | Request Mechanism | Primary Contact (ITO) | Primary Contact (EA) | Output |
| ------------ | ------------ | ----------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | ------ |
| Concept Review Board (CRB) | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [CRB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/concept-review-board.md) | Director/Sr. Manager (Area Lead) | Governance EA Lead / EA Domain Lead | Concept Validation, Initial Guidance, ARB Readiness Assessment |
| Architecture Review Board (ARB) | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [ARB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/architecture-review-board.md) | Director/Sr. Manager (Area Lead) | Governance EA Lead / EA Domain Lead | Architecture Decision Record, Approval/Recommendations |
| Security Domain Review | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [DRB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md) | Senior Director / Area Lead | Governance EA Lead / Security EA Lead | Security Assessment, Compliance Guidance |
| AI Domain Review | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [DRB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md) | Senior Director / Area Lead | Governance EA Lead / AI EA Lead | AI/ML Assessment, Compliance Guidance |
| Cloud Architecture Consultation | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: Architecture Review | Director, Engineering (Cloud) | EA Domain Lead | Cloud Architecture Guidance, Standards Alignment |
| Database Architecture Standards | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: Architecture Review | Sr. Manager (Databases) | EA Domain Lead / Information Architecture EA Lead | Database Design Patterns, Standards Documentation |
| Tool Standards & Governance | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [CRB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/concept-review-board.md) | Sr. Manager (Toolchain & Automation) | Governance EA Lead | Tool Approval, Standards Documentation |
| Information Architecture Guidance | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: Architecture Review | Sr. Manager (Databases) | Information Domain Lead | Information Model, Data Strategy Alignment |
| Infrastructure Standards Exception | ITO Infrastructure | GainwellNow: [ARB Submission Process](../governance/governing-bodies/architecture-review-board.md) | Director/Sr. Manager (Area Lead) | EA Domain Lead / Governance EA Lead | Exception Approval, Risk Assessment |
| Sales Solution Architecture Support | EA Practice | Meeting Request | Sr. Manager (Architecture & Solutioning) | Sales Solution Architect | Technical Solution Design, Feasibility Assessment |
